1.why: The sans-serif typeface is legible with comfortable line spacing, though letter spacing appears only moderately generous rather than clearly widened.

2.why: No italics, all-caps, or dense paragraphs appear on any screen; all text is short sentence-case lines.

3.why: The single-column mobile-width layout is readable, but by step 8 up to eight stacked duplicate error banners dominate the screen and push the form far down.

4.why: All instructions are short plain sentences, e.g. 'Sign in to start your security setup.' and 'Use your saved password.'

5.why: The email field shows 'Example: marcus@example.com', but no example accompanies the password field and no code-entry screen was ever reached.

6.why: No screen requires reading a long block of text; even the repeated errors are single-line messages.

7.why: No copy-to-clipboard affordance is visible on any screen, and the demo credentials/password can only be typed manually.

8.why: No QR code or equivalent alternative to manual entry is offered anywhere in the eight screenshots.

9.why: The 'Use your saved password' hint and standard-looking email/password fields suggest password-manager support, though autofill attributes cannot be directly verified from the screenshots.

10.why: The 'Step 1 of 4 · Sign in' label and single large blue button are clear, though the growing stack of red banners increasingly competes for attention.

11.why: Each screen requests only one main action (the 'Sign in' button); 'Need help?' is a secondary collapsed disclosure.

12.why: Each failed attempt merely adds another identical banner; the system never plainly states what happened (no explanation or success confirmation), only a generic retry instruction.

13.why: Eight consecutive retries were possible without lockout, but there are no reveal/hide or re-request options and every retry adds another punishing duplicate banner.

14.why: 'Check your email and password, then try again.' is short, non-blaming, and gives a fix, but only implies rather than explicitly states the problem.

15.why: No countdown, session timer, or reading time limit appears on any screen.
